newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea in mkt, sells dollars at 863.00 won.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea in mkt, sells dollars at 863.00 won.

text.p: The Bank of Korea sold dollars at 863.00 won in early Thursday morning trading to slow the local currency's fall against the dollar, dealers said.
The central bank had earlier offered to sell dollars at 876.00 won in three-month forward trading and at 889.00 won in six-month forward trading, dealers said.
The bank refused to comment on talk of its intervention in the interbank market.
The won continued to fall to 863.20 just after the intervention. It had opened the day at 862.40, after closing at 862.00 on Wednesday.
